cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：认出；承认
cards.example_en: I didn't recognise my cousin in his new school uniform.
cards.example_zh: 我没有认出穿着新校服的表哥。

cards.scene: 家庭情感 · Family Friends and Feelings
cards.example_en: She has a good relationship with her parents.

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：行动；表演
cards.example_en: We should act quickly when the fire alarm rings.
cards.example_zh: 火警响起的时候，我们应该迅速行动。

cards.example_en: Decide which club you want to join before Friday.
cards.example_zh: 星期五之前，先决定你想加入哪个社团。

cards.example_en: Short poems help students express feelings about home.
cards.example_zh: 短诗能帮助学生表达对家的感情。

cards.example_en: Older classmates help younger ones with difficult homework.
cards.example_zh: 高年级同学在较难的作业上帮助低年级同学。

cards.example_en: I hope the rain stops before our family picnic.
cards.example_zh: 我希望家庭野餐开始前雨能停。

cards.example_en: We invite our neighbours to the New Year dinner.
cards.example_zh: 我们邀请邻居们来家里吃年夜饭。

cards.example_en: Could you move your chair so the aisle stays clear?
cards.example_zh: 你能把椅子挪一下，好让过道保持畅通吗？

cards.example_en: Could you suggest a quiet place for group study?
cards.example_zh: 你能建议一个适合小组学习的安静地方吗？

cards.example_en: We use chopsticks at home and forks at the canteen.
cards.example_zh: 我们在家用筷子，在食堂用叉子。

cards.example_en: Cover the pot while the soup is still boiling.
cards.example_zh: 汤还在煮的时候，把锅盖上。

cards.example_en: Enter the museum through the wide main gate.
cards.example_zh: 从宽阔的正门进入博物馆。

cards.example_en: The canteen will offer free soup on rainy days.
cards.example_zh: 下雨天食堂会提供免费的汤。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：更喜欢
cards.example_zh: 大多数学生更喜欢小组作业。
